entities.name: Phoenix
entities.description: A mythical fire bird that turns to ash when it dies but can be reborn from them; red-aligned across many planes.

entities.name: Worldheart Phoenix
entities.description: A phoenix that manifested on Alara during the events of the Conflux.

entities.name: Syrix, Carrier of the Flame
entities.description: A Legendary Phoenix from Capenna, visibly covered in metallic plating, about which little is known.

entities.name: Xuatl
entities.description: A scaled bird formed from the sun's fire said to sleep in Ixalan's mountains, molting during the summer months.

entities.name: Tilonalli
entities.description: A figure of the Sun Empire whose messengers the sunbirds are believed to be.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The people of Ixalan who call phoenixes sunbirds.

entities.name: Yinglong
entities.description: The Ancestor Dragon of Shenmeng from whom the plane's phoenixes were born.

entities.name: Skarrgan Firebird
entities.description: The only known phoenix of natural origin on Ravnica, living in the Gruul territory of Skarrg.

entities.name: Arclight Phoenix
entities.description: A bird of prey formed entirely of electrical energy on Ravnica, of disputed origin.

entities.name: Kuhnde
entities.description: A mantis rider who in the original timeline defeated a phoenix and hoped to train it as a mount.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: The Theros god associated with the phoenixes that nest in volcanoes.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: People of Keld who believe a phoenix is an omen of war.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane where phoenixes are rare.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane with phoenixes on Shiv, Jamuura and Keld.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane where phoenixes resemble owls.

entities.name: Shenmeng
entities.description: A plane whose phoenixes are fire-elemental birds like the Fenghuang.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane with the Skarrgan Firebird and arclight phoenixes.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane whose phoenixes nest in volcano craters.

events.summary: The Worldheart Phoenix manifests on Alara during the events of the Conflux.
events.quote: One known exemplar was the Worldheart Phoenix who manifested during the events of the Conflux .

events.summary: In the original Tarkir timeline, the mantis rider Kuhnde defeats a phoenix and hopes to train it as a mount.
events.quote: the mantis rider Kuhnde managed to defeat a phoenix and hoped to train it as a mount

events.summary: A Theran phoenix lays one egg in its life and plunges itself into its volcano at the end, upon which the egg hatches and a new phoenix is born.
events.quote: A phoenix lays just one egg during its centuries-long life

relations.note: Theran phoenixes are associated with Purphoros because they nest in volcanoes.
relations.quote: Theran Phoenixes make their nests within the craters of volcanoes and are therefore associated with Purphoros .

relations.note: Sunbirds are believed to be Tilonalli's messengers.
relations.quote: believe them to be messengers of Tilonalli

relations.note: Shenmeng's phoenixes were born from the Ancestor Dragon.
relations.quote: They were born from the Ancestor Dragon Yinglong
